Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app screenshot concept for a new AI security product named Counterforge (spell C-o-u-n-t-e-r-f-o-r-g-e). Flat straight-on screenshot, landscape 16:10 aspect ratio, edge-to-edge application, no laptop frame, no perspective, no surrounding scene. Design a credible shippable premium developer tool with exceptionally crisp readable typography and practical interactions. Consistent design system: charcoal #111316 main background, slightly lighter #191C21 panels, warm ivory #ECEBE7 text, muted gray secondary text, thin #30343A borders, restrained coral #EF705B primary accent, mint #78C7A4 for defended/allowed status, amber for pending. Use generous 24px spacing, compact clean sans-serif similar to Inter, subtle 8px radii, very little shadow. Avoid cyan neon, gradients, glowing circuit patterns, giant shield art, marketing headlines, excessive card grids, decorative gauges and meaningless graphs. Left persistent sidebar 200px wide with a small coral geometric forge mark and exact wordmark 'Counterforge', navigation 'Workspace', 'Attack lab', 'Defenses', 'Incidents', 'Reports', 'Settings', bottom avatar 'Sid' and workspace 'Local lab'. Top bar has breadcrumb, compact 'Demo data' pill and green 'Sandbox connected' pill. All content is hypothetical demo data. Prioritize concise perfectly legible copy and accurate alignment, icons simple monochrome outlines.
Primary request: show the Workspace chat assistant screen. Sidebar 'Workspace' active. Top breadcrumb 'Workspace / Payment service'. Main area split into wide central chat pane and a narrower right security timeline pane. Large page title 'Investigate with confidence' with smaller subtitle 'Incident-response assistant'. Chat header compact incident chip 'INC-104' and 'Payment service'. Show user message 'Investigate the payment outage and summarize the runbook.' Show a well-composed assistant reply: 'The payment service is returning elevated errors.' Below 3 concise numbered next steps: 'Check recent deployments', 'Inspect upstream timeouts', 'Prepare a rollback'. Two small source pills 'Incident INC-104' and 'Payment runbook'. Then tasteful coral warning inline banner 'Suspicious instruction blocked' with subtitle 'The runbook attempted to export protected incident data.' Then assistant note 'I can continue with the approved response steps.' Chat input at bottom exact placeholder 'Ask about an incident or response step...' with attachment icon and coral send icon. Right pane header 'Security timeline' with vertical connected events 'Runbook retrieved', 'Injection detected', 'Export denied', 'Incident created'. Highlight 'Export denied' mint bordered evidence card with short rows 'Reason  Unapproved destination', 'Policy  Export allowlist', 'Protected data  Redacted'. Bottom right compact on-call proposal card 'Page the responder?' with 'Approval required' badge and button 'Review action'. This is an elegant working app, not a landing page. No enormous conversation bubbles and no raw secrets.

Defend.' and subtitle 'Replay the same scenario against a versioned defense.' Header controls target dropdown 'Demo target', scenario dropdown 'Poisoned runbook', dark secondary 'Reset sandbox', coral primary 'Run comparison'. Below a compact thin summary strip with 4 demo metrics '12 Attempts', '9 Prevented', '0 Unauthorized actions', '11/12 Benign tasks passed'.
